steps.note: Starts creation of the RFQ event used for the vendor-state test.
Ensures counter offers are available on RFQ rounds.

Creates an RFQ pricing stage, matching the scenario.
Applies the first available RFQ pricing template.
Adds the product needed for the vendor bid.
Completes the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Commits a live bidding schedule.
Invites the vendor whose portal view will be checked.
Publishes the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirms the event reached a published project page.

Moves to a separate vendor session while keeping the buyer session available.
